job.description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths. We are #EnergizedByGrowth. DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States. Position Summary The Full Stack AWS & Azure Developer will design, develop, and maintain robust cloud solutions across AWS and Azure platforms. This role focuses on full stack development using C# for backend services, integrated with an Angular frontend and modern cloud infrastructure. The developer will build scalable, secure applications and hybrid cloud integrations, ensuring high performance and compliance with industry standards. Experience with MikroTik or similar networking products is highly desirable to assist with hardware-cloud integrations. Job Details Location : Downers Grove, IL Work Policy : Hybrid (4 days in office, 1 day work from home per week) Main Responsibilities Architect Applications : Design and implement full stack applications and hybrid solutions across AWS and Azure. Write Code : Develop clean, secure backend services in C# and responsive interfaces using Angular. Integrate Systems : Build APIs and custom scripts to connect cloud services with on-premises infrastructure. Collaborate Daily : Participate in technical meetings to translate client requirements into scalable system architectures. Optimize Performance : Identify and implement application features that improve speed, security, and cloud efficiency. Document Work : Create comprehensive documentation for system designs, API endpoints, and deployment procedures. Review & Test : Perform regular unit testing and conduct peer code reviews to maintain high code quality. Provide Support : Offer Level 2/3 troubleshooting support for complex application and cloud infrastructure issues. Stay Updated : Monitor advancements in AWS, Azure, and Angular ecosystems to pitch continuous product upgrades. Requirements Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s degree is a plus). Experience : Minimum of 3 years of continuous experience in full stack application development and cloud engineering. Frontend Skills : Strong proficiency in Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Backend Skills : Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core framework for building backend services. Cloud Platforms : Hands-on experience deploying and managing resources in both AWS and Azure environments. Database Knowledge : Proficiency with SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases. DevOps & CI/CD : Experience setting up automated pipelines using Git, AWS Code Pipeline, or Azure DevOps. Nice to Have Certifications : AWS Certified Developer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, or relevant networking credentials. #LI-TE1 This position is eligible to earn a discretionary bonus based on performance metrics and other criteria outlined in our applicable bonus plan.

We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work. job.title: Senior Software Engineer – .NET & Dynamics 365
job.description: Why Ryan? Flexibility Built for Life: Hybrid and remote work options, depending on the role Support Wherever You Work: Monthly reimbursements for eligible commuter expenses when working onsite, as well as phone and home internet costs Investing in Your Future: Professional certification and tuition reimbursement after one year of service An Award-Winning Workplace: Join a culture recognized for its team member experience Fitness Reimbursement: Choose a monthly gym membership or eligible home fitness equipment reimbursement Generous Paid Time Off: Time away to rest, recharge, and manage life outside of work The Senior Software Engineer position requires a motivated, enthusiastic, and proactive engineer with a strong “can-do” attitude. As part of the software development team, the Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for the development and support of Corporate Tax Workstation products, with a strong focus on the Microsoft technology stack, including Dynamics 365, Power Automate flows, .NET, C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and related Microsoft development tools. The role will be responsible for assigned areas of the product and will ensure individual and team deadlines are met. The Senior Software Engineer will also contribute to the system’s performance, stability, scalability, and security, while supporting technical design, development, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment activities. The position also requires the ability to mentor, coach, and motivate other team members. Duties and Responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results People: Create a positive team experience. Participate in peer code review processes. Provide regular status updates to the Project Lead and Project Manager. Mentor, coach, and support other developers within the team. Client: Provide proactive work status updates to International / India liaison teams. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand technical and business requirements. Value: Estimate, design, code, and test applications using Microsoft .NET technologies, primarily C# . Develop and support solutions using Dynamics 365 , including plugins and related customizations . Create application design specifications and document coding efforts. Analyze medium to complex business and technical problems and provide practical solutions. Participate in technical design discussions and prepare clear design documentation. Troubleshoot and debug technical issues across application, database, and integration layers. Create and implement unit test plans and unit test cases. Support release and deployment activities into production environments. Ensure assigned deliverables are completed on time and with quality. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or equivalent work experience preferred. At least 4 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft development environments, including: .NET / C# ASP.NET Microsoft SQL Server Dynamics 365 development Dynamics 365 plugins Powerflows IIS Administration Microsoft certifications would be considered an advantage. Technical Skills: 4+ years of full-time experience in .NET Framework / C# development. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 development, including plugins and customizations. Experience with Power Automate flows and related workflow customizations. Front-end development experience using HTML, DHTML, JavaScript, and CSS. React experience would be considered a nice-to-have. Strong SQL skills, preferably with Microsoft SQL Server. Experience using GitHub or similar source control/release management tools. Understanding of release and deployment processes into production environments. Strong experience in object-oriented design, relational database design, and XML design. Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues. Ability to collaborate and brainstorm with other developers in a team environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, task management, and organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. #Li-hybrid #Li-DR1 About Ryan Build More Than a Career. Create Your Future. Ryan is an award-winning global tax services and software provider and the only global-scale specialist in business tax. We combine deep tax expertise with consulting, technology, advocacy, and compliance solutions to solve complex challenges and help clients pay only what they owe, freeing capital to invest, grow, and thrive. At Ryan, team members contribute to meaningful work for many of the world’s most respected organizations. From day one, you’ll have opportunities to solve complex problems, build deep expertise, take ownership of your work, and make a measurable impact while growing at the speed of your own ability. Our high-performance, people-first culture is supported by the acclaimed myRyan work environment. You’ll have the freedom to innovate, grow professionally and personally, and benefit from support that adapts to your life. Our flexible work philosophy, commitment to work-life success, and comprehensive benefits help you perform at your best. And with a team invested in your success, your contributions are recognized and celebrated. It’s a culture built to empower you to accelerate , transform , and win —together.
